heuristics: H1 coverage: the 6N^2 distinct rationals a w/(u a' w') hit z like independent uniform elements of H (toy: 0.4025 measured vs 0.3935 predicted, 400 trials)
H2/H2' H-prime density 1/2^20 among primes and exponential gaps (list sizes and the 2^33 gap bound, checked when the lists are built)
H3 key bits: 192-bit parity y-keys behave as independent uniform strings across mu6 orbits (bucket occupancy, comparison and false-match caps; toy chi-square 31.32 vs 31)
limitations: Analytic bound; no full-size run. Instruction counts itemised, not measured on hardware.
Memory is exponential (2^124.0 bytes with every node at its full allocation; records alone 2^120.66).
Per-node comparison cap, per-slot cap, candidate cap and node overflow make the run fail with total probability below 2^-20 under H3; charged work is the maximum, not the expectation.
Depends on the walk-with-one-addition idea of cbadde77 and the H-prime semiprime construction of 6ecec8e3 / cf6d45a8; the change is the matching stage.
